'''Jason Adam Griffith''' is an American actor and voice actor for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}. He is sometimes credited as '''J. Griff''' or '''Adam Caroleson'''.

==Biography==
Griffith was born on November 29, 1980, in Lakeline, Ohio, and became a voice actor as an adult. He began to provide voices for Pokémon during {{aniseries|AG}}. His initial tenure with the series ended after [[S08|the eighth season]], when [[4Kids Entertainment]] [[Pokémon USA recasting controversy|gave up the dubbing and distribution of the series]] to {{TPCi|Pokémon USA}} and [[TAJ Productions]]. He later returned in ''[[DP082|Cream of the Croagunk Crop!]]''. In {{aniseries|BW}}, Griffith gained his most significant role, providing the voice of {{an|Cilan}}. Griffith is currently affiliated with Innovative Artists.

==Other non-Pokémon roles==
Griffith was best known for voicing '''Sonic the Hedgehog''' in Sonic X and every Sonic game from ''{{wp|Shadow the Hedgehog (game)|Shadow the Hedgehog}}'' to ''{{wp|Sonic & The Black Knight}}'', replacing {{wp|Ryan Drummond}}, Sonic's previous voice actor, and being replaced by {{wp|Roger Craig Smith}}. He also did the voice of two of Sonic's rivals: {{wp|Shadow the Hedgehog|Shadow}} and {{wp|Babylon Rogues|Jet}}.

==Trivia==
* Griffith has voiced two Gym Leaders who happen to share their Gym Leader status with their siblings: [[Cilan]] and [[Tate and Liza|Tate]]. Cilan and Tate are also both the result of a {{wp|multiple birth}}, with Cilan being a triplet with [[Chili]] and [[Cress]] and Tate being the twin brother of Liza.
* Griffith is the first returning former 4Kids voice actor who has gained a role of a main character during the TPCi dub. The second is [[Rebecca Soler]].
